name: Slice and Dice
when: Slice and Dice is down at any combo points, with 6s or more of the fight left. At 5 combo points, also when it has under 3s left with over 9s of the fight left, or when [[tal:Rogue:1:18|Adrenaline Rush]] or [[tal:Rogue:1:15|Blade Flurry]] is ready and waiting for it

name: Adrenaline Rush
when: Under 39 Energy and Slice and Dice has over 1s left
notes: Adrenaline Rush anchors the big window. Low Energy wastes none of its extra regen.

name: Blade Flurry
when: Slice and Dice has over 1s left
notes: Blade Flurry is auto attack speed and does not feed the energy window, so it goes on cooldown.

name: Cold Blood
when: 5 combo points, the Energy for Eviscerate and over 6s of Slice and Dice, unless the points are going to a Slice and Dice for [[tal:Rogue:1:18|Adrenaline Rush]] or [[tal:Rogue:1:15|Blade Flurry]]
notes: The next hit spends it.

name: Eureka!
when: Slice and Dice has over 8s left
notes: For 8 sec, abilities cost 10% less and hit 10% harder.
why: Why on cooldown? This build rarely reaches a 5-point Eviscerate, so saving Eureka! for one wastes it.

name: Blood Fury
when: With [[tal:Rogue:1:18|Adrenaline Rush]], unless waiting for it would cost a use

name: Elune's Light
when: With [[tal:Rogue:1:18|Adrenaline Rush]], unless waiting for it would cost a use

when: When ready

name: Blackhand's Breadth

name: Thistle Tea

notes: So all 100 Energy fit.

name: Goblin Sapper Charge
when: Slice and Dice is up

name: Goblin Land Mine
when: Slice and Dice is up and within 0.4s after a main-hand swing
notes: Its 1s cast then loses no swing time.

name: Other cooldowns
when: Trinkets, racials and potions not listed here, as soon as they are ready

name: Eviscerate
when: 4+ combo points while Slice and Dice is up, at 79+ Energy or in the last 6s of the fight. In the last 3s, any combo points
why: Why 4 combo points when Combat Swords waits for 5? Seal Fate gives a crit a second point, so waiting for a fifth often wastes one.

name: Shank
when: 75 or less Energy
notes: Shank on cooldown at 75 energy or less, so the Energy it gives back fits; with [[tal:Rogue:0:13|Venom]] it also keeps the poisons' buff up.

name: Sinister Strike
when: When ready
notes: Sinister Strike whenever it is affordable.

name: Ambush
